en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing the entrance to a castle complex. A curved stone bridge and walls lead to a gatehouse and main building with steep tiled roofs. A small tower with a bulbous dome and cross rises above. Several people, including children, stand or walk along the approach. Trees frame the scene. Printed red text at the top reads the location and indicates it is the entrance to the castle.
